continuity: Morgoth’s attack and the bomb’s blast destroy Moscow and its surrounding metropolitan area; the narrator hears a minimum estimate of twenty million dead, with no signs of life.
Pie Chen, an S-rank Hunter from Hong Kong and the narrator’s friend, died a week earlier after making a last stand against Morgoth and refusing to follow him.
Chuck Hagel survived because of Pie Chen’s sacrifice; he has only his right arm left and says he wishes he had died in her place.
The United States President announces that the returning savior has come back; the narrator vows to prevent further sacrifices and intends to face Morgoth.
plot: A livestream captures Morgoth’s destruction of Moscow, caused by the hydrogen bomb hidden in the Kremlin. After the United States President announces that the returning savior has come back, the narrator watches footage of the devastation and Pie Chen’s death a week earlier. Pie died fighting Morgoth after refusing to follow him; Chuck Hagel, who survived because of her sacrifice, regrets living. The narrator vows not to let anyone else be sacrificed.
translation_decisions: Retain “Erasure” for 소멸 and “Black Dragon Duke” for 흑룡공.

active_continuity: Vladimir, powered by a Magic Gem, destroyed Moscow; Morgoth survived the blast and created a Dragon Lair over the ruins.
Morgoth’s attack on Moscow was broadcast worldwide; the narrator hears a minimum death estimate of twenty million and no signs of life.
Pie Chen, the narrator’s friend and an S-rank Hunter from Hong Kong, died a week earlier fighting Morgoth rather than joining him.
Chuck Hagel survived because of Pie Chen’s sacrifice; he has only his right arm left and regrets that she died in his place.
The United States President announced that the returning savior has come back; the narrator vows to prevent further sacrifices and intends to face Morgoth.
open_questions: How will the nations respond to Morgoth’s destruction of Moscow?
temporary_decisions: Render 블라디미르 as “Vladimir,” 흑룡공 as “Black Dragon Duke,” and 파이 첸 as “Pie Chen.”
